headline: Countdown to O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Q2 Earnings: A Look at Estimates Beyond Revenue and EPS
summary: Besides Wall Street's top-and-bottom-line estimates for O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY), review projections for some of its key metrics to gain a deeper understanding of how the company might have fared during the quarter ended June 2026.
